passages.title: Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a popular park
passages.text: Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a popular park. This park was full of fun things to do. Kids loved to play there all day long. One sunny day, a new toy came to the park. It was a big spray water toy. All the kids were very happy. They ran to the toy to play with the water. They laughed and had lots of fun. But then, something unexpected happened. The spray water toy started to spray juice! The kids were so surprised. They loved it even more. They played and drank juice from the toy. The park became more popular and fun than ever before.

passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a curious bear who lived in the woods. He had never seen rain before. One morning he woke up to a damp feeling and strange sound. He was so curious he decided to go outside and see what it was. When he opened his door, he saw rain! He had no idea what it was and he started to suffer. He didn't know why the rain was filling the air and wondered why it felt so cold. He began to cry and all the animals in the woods came to see what was wrong. A little rabbit saw the tears on the bear's face. “Why are you crying?” said the rabbit. passages.title: One day, a dog named Max was very enthusiastic
passages.text: One day, a dog named Max was very enthusiastic. He loved to run and play outside. Max also liked to chew on his toys. He had a big red ball that he liked to chew all the time. One afternoon, dark clouds came and a storm started. Max was scared of the storm, so he went inside his house. He sat by the window and watched the rain fall. The storm made loud noises, but Max felt safe in his house. After the storm was over, Max went outside to play again. He found his big red ball and started to chew on it. Max was happy that the storm was gone, and he could play with his favorite toy again.

passages.title: Once there was a lazy bug
passages.text: Once there was a lazy bug. He lived in a big tree. One day, he stumbled as he was walking up the tree and fell off the branch. He was scared and couldn't get back up. Suddenly an insect appeared. It was a big spider! It was fierce and scurried towards the bug. The bug was scared and he tried to escape, but it was too late. The spider had caught the bug in it's web. The bug did his best to struggle, but it was not enough. He was too weak and too lazy to escape. Soon, the spider took the bug back to its home and ate him. It was a bad ending for the lazy bug.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a famous cat
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a famous cat. The cat was famous for its pretty fur. The cat lived in a big house with many stairs. The cat liked to play on the stairs all day long. One day, the cat gazed at the top stair. The cat saw a big, red ball. The cat thought, "I want to play with the big, red ball." So, the cat climbed up the stairs to get the ball. When the cat reached the top stair, the ball was gone. The cat was sad. But then, the cat heard a giggle. The cat turned around and saw a little girl. The girl had the big, red ball. The girl said, "Let's play together!" The cat was happy and they played all day long.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a big, hairy dog named Spot
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a big, hairy dog named Spot. Spot liked to play outside under the blue sky. One day, he saw a funny cloud that looked like a bone. Spot wanted to show his friend, Kitty. "Kitty, come see the cloud!" Spot said. Kitty looked up and saw the bone cloud too. They laughed and played, trying to catch the cloud. Spot had an idea. "Let's lead the cloud to our friends!" he said. So, Spot and Kitty walked, and the cloud followed them. They showed the cloud to their friends, who all laughed and played under the bone cloud. They had a great day together, and the cloud stayed with them until it was time to go to bed.

passages.title: Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a boy named Tim
passages.text: Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a thick leather ball. He loved to play with it every day. One day, a big dog came to play with Tim. The dog was very strong and wanted to play with the ball too. Tim said, "Let's play together, but be gentle with my ball." The dog wagged its tail and they began to play. They would throw the ball and pull it back. They had lots of fun. But then, the dog pulled the ball too hard. The thick leather ball broke. Tim was very sad. He tried to fix the ball, but it was too late. The dog felt bad too, and walked away with its head down. Tim learned that not all playmates are careful with our things.

passages.title: Once upon a time, in a small town, there was an unusual little girl na
passages.text: Once upon a time, in a small town, there was an unusual little girl named Lily. She loved to put her toys in a big box. Every day, she played with her toys and put them back in the box when she was done. One sunny day, Lily saw a pretty bird outside her window. The bird flew to the east, and Lily wanted to follow it. So, she put on her shoes and went outside. She walked and walked, looking for the bird. As she walked east, Lily found a new park she had never seen before. There were swings, slides, and lots of kids playing. Lily felt happy and played with the new friends she made. After a fun day, she went back home and told her mom about her unusual adventure.

passages.title: One day, a boy named Tim had a toy rocket
passages.text: One day, a boy named Tim had a toy rocket. It was red and blue. He loved to play with it. He would shoot it into the sky and watch it zoom up high. Tim was very happy when he played with his rocket. Tim had a friend named Sue. Sue liked to play with paint. She made messy art with lots of colors. One day, Sue came over to play with Tim. They decided to make the rocket messy with paint. They laughed and had fun. After the rocket was messy, Tim and Sue went outside. They counted to three and shot the rocket into the sky. They watched it zoom up high with the paint flying off. The messy rocket made a beautiful sky. Tim and Sue smiled and clapped their hands.

passages.text: One day, a swan named Sally was very anxious. She had to sort her toys into boxes. She had a big pile of toys and three boxes. One box was for soft toys, one box was for round toys, and one box was for long toys. Sally's friend, a duck named Danny, came to help. "I can help you sort your toys," said Danny. "Thank you," said Sally. They started to sort the toys together. They put the soft toys in one box, the round toys in another box, and the long toys in the last box. When they finished, Sally was not anxious anymore. She was very happy. Sally and Danny played with the toys all day. They had lots of fun. passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. Tom was a serious boy. He liked to play with his toy car and eat candy. One day, Tom went to the store with his mom. He saw a big jar of candy. Tom's eyes got big and he wanted some. Tom's mom said, "You can have some candy if you are good at the store." Tom was very good. He helped his mom put things in the cart. When they were done, Tom's mom let him pick some candy. He was so happy. On the way home, Tom heard a ring. It was the phone in his mom's bag. His mom talked on the phone and Tom ate his candy. He was a good boy and got a treat. Tom smiled and knew that being serious and good was worth it.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Jane
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Jane. She was three years old and loved to explore. One day, Jane was out riding in her daddy's car with the windows open. As they drove along, Jane noticed something shining in the grass. She asked her daddy to stop the car so she could look at it. Her daddy stopped and Jane jumped out. She ran over to the spot where she had seen the shiny thing. She bent down and reached out her hand. When she touched it, the shiny thing revealed to be a sparkly rock! passages.title: Once upon a time, in a charming little town, there was a big gate
passages.text: Once upon a time, in a charming little town, there was a big gate. Every day, a girl named Lily had to clean the gate. Lily did not like to clean the gate. She wanted to play with her friends. One day, while Lily was cleaning the gate, she found a small, hidden door. She opened the door and saw a beautiful garden. Lily went inside to look around. She found a big, friendly dog who wanted to play. Lily played with the dog and forgot about cleaning the gate. The dog helped her clean the gate very fast. Now, Lily could play with her friends and the dog too. The gate was clean, and everyone was happy.

passages.title: Once upon a time, in a charming little farm, there lived a chicken nam
passages.text: Once upon a time, in a charming little farm, there lived a chicken named Lucy. Lucy was a very happy chicken. She loved to play with her friends, the pig, the cow, and the sheep. One sunny day, Lucy and her friends decided to split up and play hide and seek. Lucy was very good at hiding. She found a big bush to hide behind. The pig, the cow, and the sheep looked for her, but they could not find her. After a while, the pig said, "Lucy, where are you?" Lucy came out from behind the bush and said, "Here I am!" Her friends were very surprised. They all laughed and played together for the rest of the day.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a curious little girl named Mia
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a curious little girl named Mia. She loved to play outside and find new things. One day, she went to the park with her mom and dad. At the park, Mia found a big pile of pebbles. She picked up a few and put them in her bucket. Then, she saw a small puddle of water. She had an idea! Mia took her bucket of pebbles and went to the puddle. She poured the pebbles into the water and watched them splash. She laughed and clapped her hands. Mia had so much fun playing with the pebbles and water that day.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a lonely boy named Tim
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a lonely boy named Tim. Tim had no friends to play with. One day, he found a toy jeep in his room. The jeep was red and shiny. Tim was very happy. Tim loved to pretend with his jeep. He would drive it around his room, making car sounds. He would pretend the jeep was going on big adventures. The jeep would drive up high mountains and cross deep rivers. Tim and the jeep were best friends. One day, Tim took his jeep outside to play. He pretended the jeep was driving through a big jungle. But, Tim was not careful. He left the jeep on the road. A big car came and ran over the jeep. The jeep broke into pieces. Tim was very sad and lonely again.

passages.text: Once upon a time in a big jungle, there was a lion named Leo. Leo liked to roar very loud. All the animals in the jungle were frightened when they heard Leo's roar. One day, Leo was not feeling well. His tummy hurt so much that he could not roar. His friend, Ellie the elephant, said, "Leo, you need to see Dr. Bird for an operation." Leo was scared, but he knew he needed help. Dr. Bird, the wise doctor, fixed Leo's tummy with a special operation. After the operation, Leo felt much better. He thanked Dr. Bird and said, "Thank you, Dr. Bird. I am not frightened anymore." Now, Leo could roar loud again, but he learned to be kind to the other animals. passages.text: One day, a little boy named Tim went to a fun place with his mom. This place was for kids to learn and play. Tim was very happy and enthusiastic. He saw many things to do and many friends to play with. At the fun place, there was a nice lady who gave a lecture. She talked about animals and their sounds. Tim listened to the lady and tried to understand what she said. He liked the part where she talked about how the cow says "moo" and the dog says "woof." Tim's mom asked him, "Did you understand what the lady said?" Tim smiled and said, "Yes, mom! I learned that the cow says 'moo' and the dog says 'woof.'" passages.title: One day, a little girl named Lily went to the park
passages.text: One day, a little girl named Lily went to the park. She saw a silly dog wearing a big hat. The dog was playing with a ball. Lily laughed and clapped her hands. Lily went home and told her mom about the silly dog. Her mom said, "That sounds fun! Let's have a part of the park day tomorrow." Lily was very happy. The next day, Lily and her mom went to the park. They brought a big cabinet to put their toys and food in. They found the silly dog and played all day. At the end of the day, they said, "Bye, silly dog! See you soon!"

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a gifted little boy named Tim
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a gifted little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy cars. He would drive them all around his room, making fun sounds like "vroom, vroom!" One day, Tim went to the big city with his mom and dad. They took the subway to get there. Tim was excited because it was his first time on a subway. It was like a big train that went under the ground. When they got to the city, Tim saw a big toy store. His mom and dad took him inside, and there were so many toys! They bought Tim a new toy car as a gift. Tim was very happy and couldn't wait to go home and drive his new car around his room.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a polite horse named Happy
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a polite horse named Happy. Happy lived in a stable with his friends. They played and ate together every day. One day, Happy got hurt while playing. His friends were sad. They wanted to help Happy heal. They brought him soft grass to eat and fresh water to drink. After some days, Happy started to feel better. He could walk and play again. His friends were so happy. They played and laughed together in the stable. And they all lived happily ever after.

passages.title: One day, a rat named Tom found a unique red hat
passages.text: One day, a rat named Tom found a unique red hat. He wanted to wear it, but it was too big. Tom tried to manage to make the hat fit, but he could not. He felt sad and asked his friend, a bird named Sue, for help. "Can you help me make this hat fit?" Tom asked Sue. Sue thought for a moment and said, "Yes, I have an idea!" Sue found some soft grass and put it inside the hat. The hat fit Tom just right now. Tom was very happy. As Tom wore his unique red hat, he walked around the park. Suddenly, the wind blew the hat off his head. The hat flew high into a tree. Tom was sad again. But then, Sue flew up and got the hat back for Tom. They both laughed and played, happy to have each other as friends.

passages.title: Once upon a time, in a dark forest, there lived a kind judge
passages.text: Once upon a time, in a dark forest, there lived a kind judge. He liked to help people and animals. One day, he met a little girl who was sad. She wanted to play in the forest, but her mom did not permit her. The judge wanted to make the girl happy, so he said, "You can play here, but be careful. The forest can be scary." passages.text: Once upon a time there lived two little animals. One was a rabbit and one was a deer. The rabbit liked to look beautiful and was often washing in a hose. One day, when the rabbit was away, the deer saw its reflection in the hose and exclaimed, "I'm beautiful too!" From then on, the deer always believed in itself and looked beautiful. The moral of the story is to believe in yourself no matter what. You can always be beautiful if you just believe it!

Sam hugged him and said, "You did it, Tim! You are so brave!" And they both went to play some more in the park.

passages.title: Once there was a little girl named Sarah
passages.text: Once there was a little girl named Sarah. Sarah was very thoughtful. She liked to help her mom around the house. One morning, Sarah saw her mom in the bathroom and she thought about how she could help. So, Sarah grabbed a little bucket of water and started to clean the toilet. She worked and worked until she finished. Mommy was so happy when she saw what Sarah had done. She hugged Sarah and thanked her for being so thoughtful. Sarah felt very proud of herself for helping her mom. She was happy for the rest of the day and every day after that. Mommy and Sarah became even better friends after that.

passages.title: One day, a small dog named Bob was playing in the park
passages.text: One day, a small dog named Bob was playing in the park. He liked to run and jump. Bob saw a big pit and thought it would be fun to play in it. Bob jumped into the pit and started to dig. He dug and dug, but then he felt sad. He was stuck in the pit and could not get out. Bob tried to jump, but the pit was too deep. A big, kind bird saw Bob and wanted to help. The bird flew down into the pit, and Bob climbed onto the bird's back. The bird flew up and out of the pit. Bob was very happy and thanked the bird. They became good friends and played together in the park every day.

Lucy was sad and didn't know what to do. She looked around for help. Then, she saw a police car with a friendly police dog named Max. Max saw that Lucy was sad and wanted to support her. So, Max and Lucy looked for the ball together. They looked under cars and in the grass. At last, they found the ball near a big tree. Lucy was so happy to have her ball back. She thanked Max for his help. From that day on, Lucy and Max were best friends. They played together and supported each other always.

passages.title: It was a cold winter day
passages.text: It was a cold winter day. Mommy was making hot cocoa for the family. Little Isabella wanted to go outside and play, but Mommy said it was too cold. "It's too harsh out there. You will freeze!", Mommy said. Isabella said she wanted to go look at the ants. The ants were busy outside and she wanted to watch them. "Okay," Mommy said. "But only for a few minutes, okay? And don't forget your mittens and your hat!" Isabella put on her winter gear and went outside. All the ants were busy collecting food and scurrying around. It seemed like a fun game, so Isabella started stomping around. But then the ants stopped. They seemed to be frozen in place. "Isabella, what are you doing?" Mommy said sternly.

passages.title: One day, a little boy named Tim went to his classroom
passages.text: One day, a little boy named Tim went to his classroom. He was very excited to start learning with his friends. The classroom had many toys and big, colorful books. Tim liked to play with his friends and learn new things. But today, the classroom was smelly. Tim and his friends did not like the smell. They wanted to find out where the smell came from. So, they started looking around the room. They looked under the tables and behind the big, colorful books. At last, they found the smelly thing. It was a dirty sock! Tim and his friends laughed and threw the sock away. The classroom was not smelly anymore. They were happy and started playing and learning together again.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a cool cat named Tom
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a cool cat named Tom. Tom lived in a big forest. He had many friends, but he also had a problem. A big, bad dog named Max lived there too. Max liked to scare Tom and his friends. One day, Tom had an idea. He would pick a weapon to stop Max. Tom looked around and found a big stick. He knew this stick would help him. Tom told his friends about his plan. They were all very happy. The next day, Tom saw Max coming. He hid behind a tree with his big stick. When Max got close, Tom jumped out and waved the stick. Max got scared and ran away. Tom and his friends were safe. They all cheered and played together in the forest.

passages.title: One day, a little boy named Tim was playing outside
passages.text: One day, a little boy named Tim was playing outside. He saw a big tree with many leaves. He wanted to climb the tree and have fun. He started to climb the tree but then he saw something unknown. It was a small box. Tim looked at the box and said, "What is this? I want to open it." He opened the box and found a toy inside. The toy was a little dog. Tim was very happy and said, "Wow, a new friend!" Tim played with the toy dog and they had lots of fun. But then, the toy dog started to tremble. Tim was scared and said, "What's wrong, dog?" The toy dog changed into a real dog! Tim was surprised but happy. Now he had a real dog friend to play with.

passages.title: One day, a boy named Tim woke up early
passages.text: One day, a boy named Tim woke up early. He had a wish to find a big treasure. He wanted to be rich so he could buy many toys. Tim went outside to start his search. Tim walked and walked until he met a talking frog. The frog said, "Hello, Tim! What are you looking for?" Tim said, "I want to find a treasure to be rich." The frog smiled and said, "I can help you. Follow me!" The frog led Tim to a big tree. Under the tree, they found a treasure box. The box was full of gold coins! Tim was so happy. He thanked the frog and went home. Now, Tim was rich and he could buy all the toys he wanted.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tim
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tim. Tim loved to soar high in the sky. One day, he saw a kayak on the river. The kayak was small and pretty. Tim wanted to ride the kayak. Tim asked his friend, Sam the squirrel, "Can I ride the kayak?" Sam said, "No, Tim. It is not safe for a little bird like you." But Tim did not listen. He went to the kayak and jumped in. The kayak started to move fast on the river. Tim was scared. He tried to fly away, but he could not. The kayak hit a rock and broke. Tim fell into the water. He could not swim. A big fish came and ate Tim. The moral of the story is to listen to your friends when they give you good advice.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a little cactus
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a little cactus. It lived in a big desert. The cactus was very lonely because no one came to visit it. It wanted to welcome new friends. One day, a modern bird came flying by. The bird saw the cactus and thought it looked like a fun place to rest. The bird said, "Hi, cactus! Can I sit on you?" The cactus was so happy and said, "Yes, welcome, bird!" The bird and the cactus became good friends. They played and talked every day. Soon, more animals came to visit the cactus. The cactus welcomed them all. The desert was not lonely anymore. The cactus and its friends lived happily ever after.

passages.title: One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park with his mom
passages.text: One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. Tim saw a new kid, someone unknown to him. This new kid was a pupil in another class. Tim wanted to make a new friend, so he went to say "hi" to the new kid. But the new kid did not say "hi" back. Tim felt sad and did not know what to do. He tried to play with the new kid, but the new kid did not want to play. Tim felt even more sad. Tim's mom saw him and came to help. She told Tim that sometimes, people need time to feel safe with new friends. Tim and his mom went to play on the swings. Later, the new kid came to play with them, and they all had fun together.

passages.title: One day, a small fish was swimming in the sea
passages.text: One day, a small fish was swimming in the sea. The fish saw an oyster. The oyster was unknown to the fish. The fish was curious and wanted to know more about the oyster. The fish went to the oyster and said, "Hello, I have never seen you before. Can I ask you a question?" The oyster replied, "Yes, little fish, you can ask me anything." The fish asked, "What is inside you, oyster?" The oyster smiled and said, "I have a pretty pearl inside me. It is a secret treasure." The fish was happy to learn something new and swam away to tell its friends about the unknown oyster and its secret treasure.

passages.title: One day, a cat named Tom had a plan
passages.text: One day, a cat named Tom had a plan. He wanted to find a cane. He thought having a cane would make him look cool. So, he began to search for a cane in his house. Tom looked in the living room, the kitchen, and his bedroom. Finally, he found a cane in the closet. It was a crazy cane with lots of colors. Tom was very happy. Tom walked around with his crazy cane, showing it to his friends. They all thought it was cool, too. They played with the cane and had a fun day together.

passages.title: Once upon a time there was a girl, who lived in a beautiful house
passages.text: Once upon a time there was a girl, who lived in a beautiful house. She loved to decorate, so she was always busy finding items to beautify her home. One day she decided to decorate the sink. She filled a sack with colorful stones and brought it to the sink. Then, she began to fill the sink with the stones, one by one. After she finished the sink looked very pretty! Suddenly she noticed a hidden corner beneath the sink. She started to decorate the hidden corner too, using the same colorful stones. When she finished the little corner looked very special. She stepped back and grinned with delight. "Oh, my! I sure am happy now," she said.

They all loved the fridge and the food inside. One day, Tim wanted to help his mom cook. He tried to open the fridge, but it was very hard. Tim felt a little stupid because he could not open it. He wanted to admire all the food inside the fridge. Mom saw Tim was sad and came to help. She opened the fridge and let Tim admire the food. Together, they cooked a yummy meal for the family. Tim felt happy and not stupid anymore. From that day on, Tim loved to help his mom cook and admire the food in the fridge.

Mom and Dad saw Sue. They helped her get the ornament. Sue smiled and said "thank you". Now Sue could relax with her family again.

Why are you smelly?" The dog said, "I don't know. I just smell bad." They both laughed and played together. The girl forgot about the toy she wanted to order. Then, something unexpected happened. The girl's hair got stuck in the dog's fur! They tried to get free, but they could not. They were scared and did not know what to do. A nice lady saw them and helped them. She used a brush to untangle the girl's hair from the dog's fur. They were free! The girl and the dog said, "Thank you!" The lady said, "You're welcome!

passages.title: One day, a girl named Sue found a flute
passages.text: One day, a girl named Sue found a flute. Sue liked the flute. She wanted to play it. Sue was a generous girl. She liked to share her toys with her friends. Sue went to her friend Tom's house. She wanted to play the flute with him. But when Sue got to Tom's house, she slipped on a toy. The flute flew into the air. The flute landed in a tree. Sue and Tom were sad. They wanted to play the flute. But then, a bird flew down from the tree. The bird had the flute in its beak. The bird gave the flute to Sue. Sue and Tom were happy. They played the flute together. The bird sang along with them. It was a fun day for all.

But just as the teacher was about to start the test, a big bird came and landed right in front of them. The bugs were scared and did not know what to do. passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a unique cat named Kitty
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a unique cat named Kitty. Kitty loved to play with her friends in her class. They liked to run, jump, and have fun together. One day, Kitty's teacher said they would have a test. The test was to see how high they could jump. Kitty and her friends were excited to try. Kitty jumped very high. All her friends clapped and cheered. Kitty felt happy and proud. She was the best jumper in her class. They all had a fun day and went home to tell their families about the test.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She loved organizing her room. Every day she would carefully tidy up and organize her toys. One day, she had an idea. She decided to organize her rags so they would be nice and neat. She piled them up and made them look nice. After she finished organizing, she stepped back. She smiled at her work and said, "What a peaceful raggedy pile!" But then her mom spoke up. She said, "No Lucy! You need to put those rags into a bag!" But Lucy didn't want to listen. She quickly ran to her room and shut the door. Presently, Lucy is still in her room, too frightened to come out. Her mom's still upset and the room is still messy and unorganized. Sadness

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a charming little dog named Pippin
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a charming little dog named Pippin. Pippin loved to play with his ball and run in the park. One day, while playing, he saw a big, red jug under a tree. Pippin wanted to gain the jug, so he tried to pick it up with his mouth. It was heavy, but Pippin was brave. He tried and tried, and finally, he picked up the jug and carried it to his home. When Pippin's mom saw the jug, she was happy. She filled the jug with water for Pippin to drink. Pippin was proud of his big, red jug. From that day on, Pippin and his charming jug were the best of friends.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a big gray ostrich named Ollie
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a big gray ostrich named Ollie. Ollie lived in a nice, warm place with many trees and a big pond. He had many friends, like ducks and frogs, who played with him every day. One day, Ollie found a big box near the pond. He wanted to see what was inside, so he tried to open it. He pushed and pulled, but the box would not open. Ollie felt sad and asked his friends to help him. Together, the ducks, frogs, and Ollie pushed and pulled. Finally, the box opened! Inside, they found many colorful balls to play with. They were so happy and played with the balls all day long. From that day on, Ollie and his friends had even more fun together.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a clever monkey who wanted to go up the ta
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a clever monkey who wanted to go up the tall tree. He saw a cup near the tree and he thought he could use it to climb up. So, he grabbed the cup and started to climb. At the beginning, the monkey made good progress and soon he was high up in the tree. But then things began to go wrong. The cup wasn't strong enough to hold the monkey's weight, and every time he moved, it broke a little bit more. In the end, the cup snapped and the monkey fell down from the tree. He bounced onto the ground and was hurt. The clever monkey was sad that his plan had not worked. And he never tried to climb the tree again.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a yellow car
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a yellow car. The car had many gears. It liked to drive fast and play with its car friends. They liked to race and have fun in the sun. One day, the yellow car saw a little boy. The boy had a big frown on his face. The car wanted to make the boy happy. So, it beeped its horn and did a little dance. The boy saw the yellow car dance and his frown turned into a big smile. He laughed and clapped his hands. The yellow car was happy too. It knew it had made a new friend. From that day on, the boy and the yellow car played together every day.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there were two friends called Tara and Samantha
passages.text: Once upon a time, there were two friends called Tara and Samantha. They were playing in Tara's backyard when they found an old apron. Samantha said, “Let’s wear it! It will be fun.” So, they put the apron on and started jumping and running around. They were having the best time ever until suddenly, the apron tore in two pieces! Tara felt so empty and sad. She had no idea how to fix it. Samantha said, “Let’s try putting it back together again. Look, I have some tape. We can try fixing it!” So Tara and Samantha taped the apron and when they were done, it looked almost new! They put the apron back on and kept playing until it was time to go home.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a grumpy cat named Max
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a grumpy cat named Max. Max lived in a small house with a big yard. One day, Max saw a rake in the yard. He did not like the rake, so he chose to ignore it. Max played in the yard and had fun. But then, something unexpected happened. A big wind came and blew the rake up into the air! Max was very surprised. He didn't know what to do. The rake flew high and then landed in a tree. Max was not grumpy anymore. He was happy because the rake was stuck in the tree. Now, Max could play in the yard without the rake bothering him. And from that day on, Max was a happy cat.

passages.title: One day, a big dog found a scarf
passages.text: One day, a big dog found a scarf. The scarf was very pretty and useful. The dog wore the scarf and walked around the park. He was very happy. In the park, the dog saw a little cat. The cat was cold. The dog said, "Do you want my scarf? It will make you warm." The cat said, "Yes, please!" So, the dog gave the cat his scarf. But then, something strange happened. The scarf started to increase and grow bigger and bigger! The cat and dog were very surprised. They shared the big scarf and became best friends. They were both warm and happy together.

passages.title: Once there was a small girl named Lucy
passages.text: Once there was a small girl named Lucy. She loved to play and dressed in fancy clothes. One day, Lucy's mum gave her a white glove. It was very fancy, with little sparkly sequins. “What can I do with this?” asked Lucy. “You can fold it” replied her mum. Lucy took the glove and tried to fold it. It was tricky, but she managed to do it. She opened and closed the glove, over and over again. “Look, I can make it smaller and bigger,” Lucy said proudly. “That’s great. One day, Lily's mom and dad had a big party. They invited all their friends and family. Lily saw her mom wearing a beautiful dress and her dad wearing a nice suit. Lily asked her mom, "What is happening?" Her mom said, "We are celebrating our marriage!" Lily was very happy. She played with her friends and shouted with joy. They danced and ate yummy food. Everyone had a great time at the marriage party. And Lily felt very special because her mom and dad were so happy.

passages.text: One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park. He saw a big red ball. Tim wanted to play with the ball. He ran to the ball and gave it a pinch. The ball made a funny sound. A little girl named Sue heard the sound. She came over to Tim and said, "Why did you pinch the ball?" Tim said, "I did not know it would make a sound. I was ignorant." Sue laughed and said, "That's okay. We can play together." Tim and Sue played with the red ball all day. They had fun and learned that pinching the ball made a funny sound. They were not ignorant anymore. They became good friends and played in the park every day.

Now, Bob could stand on his tree and look at his nest with pride. Bob and Cat became good friends and played together every day.

The red fox knew he could not win, so he stopped running. The red fox gave up and told the blue rabbit, "I surrender. You win." The blue rabbit was happy and they became friends. From that day on, the red fox and the blue rabbit played together in the big forest.

They got to the bird's home and had a fun day together.

Tim smiled and said, "Let's go to the park and play with the towel!" They went to the park and played with the towel. They ran around and threw the towel like a ball. But then, a big wind came. The wind took the towel away. Lily and Tim tried to catch it, but they could not. The towel was lost. Lily and Tim felt sad. They went back to Tim's house without the towel.

The boy said, "I want short hair, please." The barber cut and cut, but he made a mistake. The boy's hair was too short! The barber felt guilty. He said, "I am sorry, little boy. I made a mistake." The boy was sad, but he did not suffer. Then, something unexpected happened. A magic fairy came into the barber shop. She saw the boy and the guilty barber. The fairy said, "I can fix the boy's hair." She waved her wand and the boy's hair grew back. The boy was happy and the barber was happy too. They both thanked the magic fairy.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was an adorable little cat named Kitty
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was an adorable little cat named Kitty. Kitty loved to play outside in the sun. One day, Kitty saw a big tree and started to wonder what was on the top. Kitty said, "I want to see what's up there!" So, she climbed the tree. When she got to the top, she saw a pretty bird. The bird said, "Hi Kitty, why did you climb up here?" Kitty said, "I wanted to see what was up here in the sun!" The bird and Kitty became friends. They played together in the sun all day. And they lived happily ever after.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a family with two children
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a family with two children. Mama and Papa were very worried about the children. They had a big problem - their lawn was huge and they had no way to mow it. The children decided to help. They said, “Don’t worry Mama. We can mow the lawn! We can do it!” Mama and Papa were very proud of the children and gave them the task. So the two children got to work. They put on their shoes and started running around the lawn. They raced up and down the lawn, laughing and giggling as they went. After a while, they had mowed the entire lawn. Mama and Papa were so proud of their children! They couldn’t believe it. Moral of the story: If you work together, you can achieve anything.

They would run and swim together in the pool. Tim, Sam, and Max had so much fun. After they swam, Tim, Sam, and Max would sit and eat snacks. They would talk and laugh. They were very happy. Tim was glad he could introduce Sam to Max. They all became best friends forever.

He wanted to run up the hill and see what was on the other side. Spot ran up the hill, his little legs going fast. When he got to the top, he saw a big, green field with lots of flowers. Spot was so happy. He jumped and played in the field, rolling around in the soft grass. After playing for a long time, Spot started to feel tired. He let out a big yawn and knew it was time to go home. Spot ran back down the hill and found his way home. He curled up in his warm bed and fell fast asleep, dreaming of the fun he had on the hill.

passages.title: One day, a little boy named Tim wanted to play outside

Tim did not win the race, but he was happy he tried. After the race, Tim and Sam played with their toy cars. They had to load the cars on a big truck. They took turns loading the cars, one by one. They had fun playing together all day.

The man wanted to help the little girl. The wealthy man took off his big loop belt and gave it to the little girl. She was so happy! She put the loop on her dress and it fit perfectly. The man felt happy that he could help the little girl. They both smiled and played in the park together. The end.

So Lily and Sam played in the water together, laughing and splashing. They both had a fun day in the sun.

The moral of the story is, don't judge someone by how they look.

She wanted her flower to grow big and strong. One day, the lady talked to her flower. She said, "Little flower, I want you to grow. I will help you." The flower was happy to hear this. It wanted to grow too. Days went by, and the blue flower started to grow. It grew taller and taller. The lady was so proud of her flower. They were both happy together. And they lived happily ever after.

passages.title: Lily and Ben were at the beach with their mom and dad
passages.text: Lily and Ben were at the beach with their mom and dad. They had a lot of fun playing in the sand, splashing in the water, and looking for shells. They saw many fish, crabs, and seagulls, but they wanted to see a whale. "Mom, can we see a whale?" Lily asked. "Maybe, if we are lucky," mom said. "But whales are very big and live far away in the deep sea. We have to be quiet and patient." Lily and Ben nodded and sat on a big rock. They looked at the blue water and waited for a whale. They waited and waited, but they did not see a whale. They started to feel tired and bored. "Can we nap?" Ben asked. "Sure, you can nap," dad said. "But don't nap on the rock. passages.title: One day, a boy named Tim found a wallet on the floor
passages.text: One day, a boy named Tim found a wallet on the floor. It was different from his own wallet. He opened it and saw a picture of a man and a dog. Tim wanted to find the man and give him back his wallet. Tim took the wallet to his mom. "Mom, can I go find the man in the picture?" he asked. His mom looked at the picture and said, "Yes, I will allow you to find him, but I will go with you." They walked around the town asking people if they knew the man in the picture. Finally, they found the man at the park with his dog. Tim gave the wallet back to the man. The man was very happy and thanked Tim and his mom. From that day, Tim and the man became good friends.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to dress up in pretty clothes. One day, she put on her favorite dress and went to a fun party. At the party, there was a big table with a menu. The menu had pictures of all the tasty foods. Lily looked at the menu and saw a picture of a yummy cake. She wanted to eat the cake. Lily asked her mommy for a piece of cake. Her mommy said, "Yes, you can have some cake." Lily ate the tasty cake and was very happy. She played with her friends and had a great time at the party.

passages.title: One day, a mighty dog named Max saw some stuff on the ground
passages.text: One day, a mighty dog named Max saw some stuff on the ground. It was colorful and shiny. Max was curious and wanted to find out what it was. He picked up the stuff in his mouth and started to walk. Max met a little cat named Kitty. Kitty asked, "What do you have there, Max?" Max replied, "I don't know, but it's mighty pretty. Let's start to find where it came from." Kitty agreed, and they both went on their way. As they walked, they saw a big tree. The stuff was hanging down from its branches. Max and Kitty looked up and saw a big bird. The bird said, "That's my stuff! Thank you for finding it!" The bird was happy, and Max and Kitty felt good for helping a new friend. passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Emma
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Emma. She had a loyal dog named Max. Emma and Max loved to play together in the house. One day, Emma and Max found a door. The door led to the attic. The attic was dark and full of old things. They decided to play in the attic. Emma put on a big hat and said, "Look, Max! I am the queen!" Max wagged his tail and barked. But then, Emma tripped on a box and fell. The hat fell off her head. Emma felt embarrass. Max came to her side and licked her face. Emma laughed, and they continued to play. Emma and Max played in the attic all day. They found many fun things. They were very happy together.

passages.title: Once there was a little girl named Mary
passages.text: Once there was a little girl named Mary. Mary liked to bounce. She bounced in the living room, on the porch and even in the garden. But what Mary liked to bounce on the most were her trampoline and her bed. One day, Mary decided to have a bouncing adventure. She put on her uniform and smiled because it was so healthy looking. She bounced out the door and up the sidewalk. The wind made her feel so light, like she could just bounce away! Mary bounced to the park and discovered a new trampoline there. It was so much bigger than hers! Mary pumped her legs and bounced higher than ever before. She could almost touch the sky! When she was finally finished bouncing, Mary was very tired but very happ

passages.title: Anna and Ben are twins
passages.text: Anna and Ben are twins. They like to play together. Today is their birthday. They receive a big present from Mom and Dad. It is a big box with a picture of a beach on it. "What is it?" Anna asks. "Let's open it and see," Ben says. They rip the paper and open the box. Inside, they find two buckets, two shovels, two hats, and two towels. They also find a note from Mom and Dad. "Happy birthday, Anna and Ben! We are taking you to the beach today. Have fun!" Anna and Ben are very happy. They hug Mom and Dad and say thank you. They put on their hats and grab their buckets and shovels. They are ready to go to the beach. At the beach, Anna and Ben have a lot of fun. They make sand castles, dig holes

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a big mall
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a big mall. In the mall, there were many shops. One day, a little girl named Sue went to the mall with her mom. They wanted to buy a new dress for Sue. In the mall, they saw a nice lady. The nice lady had many dresses. Sue tried on a dress, but it was uncomfortable. Sue did not like the dress. The nice lady wanted to help. She said, "I can lend you another dress to try." Sue tried the new dress. It was not uncomfortable. It was very pretty. Sue and her mom were happy. They said "thank you" to the nice lady. Sue wore the new dress, and they went home.

passages.title: Anna and Ben are friends
passages.text: Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play outside in the park. But today it is cold and windy. Anna's mom says they need to wear coats. "Anna, put on your coat. It is cold outside," mom says. "But mom, I don't like this coat. It is boring and gray. I want a different coat," Anna says. "Sorry, Anna. This is the only coat you have. It is warm and soft. You can wear a scarf or a hat to make it more interesting," mom says. Anna is not happy. She wants a coat like Ben's. Ben's coat is red and blue and has a big star on the back. It is interesting and fun. Anna and Ben go to the park. They see a slide, a swing, and a sandbox. They run to the slide. Ben goes first. He slides down fast and laughs.

passages.title: Once, there was a young girl named Lily
passages.text: Once, there was a young girl named Lily. She liked to act in her room. She would pretend to be a princess or a superhero. Lily also had a diary where she drew her fun days. One day, Lily found a new diary under her bed. It was not her diary. She opened it and saw a map. The map showed her house and a big X in the backyard. Lily was excited and wanted to find out what the X was. Lily went to the backyard and started to dig where the X was. She dug and dug until she found a box. Inside the box was a costume. It was a costume of her favorite superhero! Now, Lily could really act like a superhero and save the day. She knew it was a special gift just for her.

passages.title: One day, a brilliant dog named Spot saw a big problem
passages.text: One day, a brilliant dog named Spot saw a big problem. A nail was in the road. Cars went by, and no one could solve the problem. Spot wanted to help. Spot thought hard. He had an idea! He ran to his friend, the big strong horse named Max. Spot told Max about the nail. Max wanted to help too. Together, Spot and Max went to the road. They waited for the cars to stop. Then, Max used his strong foot to push the nail out of the road. The cars could go by now. Spot and Max solved the problem and everyone was happy.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a loyal dog named Buddy
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a loyal dog named Buddy. Buddy loved to play with his best friend, a little boy named Tim. They would run and jump and laugh all day long. One day, Tim hurt his knee when he fell down. He could not play with Buddy like before. Buddy was sad, but he wanted to help Tim. So, Buddy would deliver Tim's toys to him. He would carry them in his mouth and bring them to Tim's side. As Tim's knee got better, he and Buddy started to play again. They were so happy to be together. Tim knew that Buddy was a loyal friend, and they had many more fun days together.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a pale little cat named Mimi
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a pale little cat named Mimi. Mimi lived in a small house with her family. In the house, there was a big fireplace that kept everyone warm. One day, Mimi was playing near the fireplace. She was having fun, but she didn't notice the wet floor. Mimi started to run and then she slipped on the wet floor. She was scared and cried because she almost fell into the fireplace. Mimi's mommy came and hugged her. She told Mimi to be careful near the fireplace and not to play there. Mimi learned to be safe and not to play near dangerous places. From that day on, Mimi played far away from the fireplace and she was always safe and happy.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a little car
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a little car. The car had wide wheels. It liked to go fast on the road. One day, the car met a big bell. The bell liked to ring loud. The car and the bell became friends. They played together every day. The car would race around the bell, and the bell would ring with joy. They had so much fun together. One day, the car and the bell went on a trip. They found a big, wide hill. The car raced up the hill and the bell rang as loud as it could. They played all day long. The car and the bell were very happy friends.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a little vehicle named Vivi
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a little vehicle named Vivi. Vivi was a happy vehicle and loved to play with her friends. They would race and chase each other all day long. Vivi could feel the wind on her face as she zoomed around. One day, Vivi was playing with her friends when she bumped into a big rock. It made Vivi feel hurt. She stopped and her friends came to see if she was okay. They all felt sad for Vivi and wanted to help her feel better. Vivi's friends helped her get up and took her to see a doctor. The doctor fixed Vivi's hurt and soon she was feeling all better. Vivi and her friends went back to playing and racing together. They were all very happy and Vivi felt good again.

passages.title: One day, a fireman had a useful red truck
passages.text: One day, a fireman had a useful red truck. He liked to help people with his truck. He had a dog that went with him to help too. The fireman and dog saw a cat in a tree. The cat said, "Help! I am stuck!" The fireman used his truck to get the cat down. The cat said, "Thank you, fireman! You are useful!" But then, something unexpected happened. The fireman's dog said, "I can help too!" Everyone was surprised that the dog could talk. The dog helped the fireman and the cat, and they all became friends. They worked together to help more people and animals.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there were two friends named Amy and Ben
passages.text: Once upon a time, there were two friends named Amy and Ben. Amy asked Ben if he wanted to go to the park. Ben was very excited and said yes! When they arrived, they saw a high slide. Amy asked Ben if he wanted to go down it. He was scared, but he said yes. When they went down the slide, they slid very fast and couldn't stop! They flew high up in the air and landed in a tall tree. Amy and Ben asked for help but no one could hear them. They stayed in the tree for days, until finally they were rescued. Unfortunately, they were never able to play in the park again.

passages.title: Once there was a wise old owl who lived in a tree
passages.text: Once there was a wise old owl who lived in a tree. Every season the owl would invite the birds of the forest to a gathering. The birds were always excited to receive an invitation and would fly to the tree where the owl lived. At the gathering the owl would tell stories of the forest and share wisdom. All of the birds would listen carefully, soaking up the owl's words. One day, a young owl asked the wise owl why they gathered every season. The wise owl smiled and said, "We gather to show that we are connected, even when we may be different. To remind us how much we can learn from each other. That is why we invite each other to come together."

passages.title: Tim and Sam were friends
passages.text: Tim and Sam were friends. They liked to play with toys. One day, they found a big box. They wanted to make a jungle with the box. They put some green paper on the box. They put some animals inside the box. They put some sticks and leaves on the box. They said, "Look, we made a jungle!" They took turns to be the animals. Tim was a lion. He roared and jumped. Sam was a monkey. He climbed and swung. They had fun. But then, Tim saw a big spider on the box. He was scared. He said, "Sam, there is a spider on the box! It is big and hairy!" passages.title: Tim liked his hat very much
passages.text: Tim liked his hat very much. It was red and had a big star on it. He wore it every day when he went to play outside. He felt happy and proud with his hat. One day, he met a big boy who was mean. The big boy saw Tim's hat and wanted it. He ran to Tim and grabbed his hat. He said, "This is my hat now. You have a baby hat. Go away!" Tim was scared and sad. He tried to get his hat back, but the big boy was too strong. He pushed Tim to the ground and ran away with his hat. He laughed and said, "Ha ha, I have a cool hat. You have nothing!" Tim cried and cried. He felt lonely and hurt. He wanted his hat back. He wanted his mom. He wanted a friend. Then, he saw a girl who was nice. She saw Tim cryin

passages.text: Once upon a time, a cheerful little girl called Grace was walking through the park. She was collecting all sorts of things, like flowers and stones. Suddenly, she heard a voice. "Hey there, little girl," it said. Grace looked around and saw an old man holding a cane. "Would you like my cane?" the old man asked. Grace was so excited that she nodded her head, jumping up and down. "Thank you," she said happily. The old man smiled and handed her the cane. Grace felt so lucky that she clasped it tightly with both hands. Every time Grace visited the park, she took her cane with her. No matter what, it always made her feel cheerful.

passages.text: Once upon a time, in a small forest, there was a little bird named Billy. Billy was sad because it was a gloomy day. The sky was gray, and the trees were dark. Billy did not want to fly or play. Billy saw a squirrel named Sally. Sally was looking for food. She found a twig on the ground. Sally said, "Hello, Billy! I found a twig for my home. Let's play together!" But Billy was too sad to play. He told Sally, "I don't want to play. It's a gloomy day." Sally had an idea. She told Billy, "Let's kneel down and look for more twigs for my home. When we help each other, we can make the gloomy day better!" Billy thought about it and agreed. passages.title: One day, a little girl named Lucy went to the park to play
passages.text: One day, a little girl named Lucy went to the park to play. She was very glad because it was a sunny day. She saw a swing and ran to it, excited to play. Lucy started to swing back and forth, higher and higher. She saw her friend Tom coming to the park too. Tom liked to play sport. He had a big ball with him. "Hi Tom!" said Lucy. "Want to swing with me?" "No, I want to play sport with my ball," said Tom. Lucy stopped swinging and went to play sport with Tom. They had a lot of fun together. They played until the sun went down and it was time to go home.

passages.title: Anna and Ben are friends
passages.text: Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big star in the sky. Anna says, "Look, Ben, a star! I want to make a wish." Ben says, "What do you wish for, Anna?" Anna thinks for a moment. She says, "I wish I could become a princess. Then I could wear a pretty dress and a crown and live in a castle." Ben says, "That sounds fun, Anna. But I wish I could become a superhero. Then I could fly and help people and fight bad guys." They close their eyes and wish hard. They hope the star will hear them. But nothing happens. They open their eyes and see that they are still in the park. They are still Anna and Ben. They feel sad. Anna says, "Maybe the star did not hear us

passages.title: Ben and Mia were twins who liked to play with their toy trains
passages.text: Ben and Mia were twins who liked to play with their toy trains. They had many engines of different colors and sizes, and they made tracks on the floor. Sometimes they pretended to mail letters and packages to each other with their trains. One day, they had a big fight over who could use the red engine. It was their favorite engine, because it was fast and shiny. They both wanted to mail a letter to their grandma with the red engine, and they did not want to share. "Give me the red engine, it's mine!" Ben shouted. "No, it's mine, I saw it first!" Mia yelled. They pulled and pushed the red engine, and it broke in half. They both started to cry. passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Spot
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Spot. Spot was very playful and loved to run around. One day, he saw a hose lying on the ground. Spot was curious and wanted to play with it. Spot went to his friend, the cat named Whiskers, and said, "Let's play with the hose!" Whiskers agreed, and they both started to play. They were having so much fun, but then they started to fight over who could play with the hose more. As they fought, their friend, the wise old owl, saw them and said, "Stop fighting, my friends. passages.title: Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a little bird named Bobo
passages.text: Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a little bird named Bobo. Bobo was enthusiastic and loved to fly. One day, he saw a big branch on a tall tree. He wanted to sit on the branch, so he tried very hard to fly up to it. Bobo tried and tried, but he could not reach the branch. He felt sad. Then, a big wind came and pushed Bobo up into the air. Bobo was happy because he was now close to the branch. He tried one more time to reach it. As Bobo got closer to the branch, he saw something unexpected. There was a big, colorful butterfly sitting on the branch! Bobo was so excited to see the butterfly. They became friends and played together all day. In the end, Bobo was happy that he tried so

passages.title: One day, a boy named Tim and his friend, Sue, were playing in the park
passages.text: One day, a boy named Tim and his friend, Sue, were playing in the park. They saw a big tent. It was dull and old. They wanted to go inside. Tim said, "Let's invite our friends to come play with us!" Sue agreed, and they ran to tell their friends about the tent. They all came to the park and went inside the tent together. Inside the tent, they found many toys and games. They played together all day. The sun went down, and it was time to go home. They all said goodbye and went back to their houses. The dull tent had made their day fun and exciting.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a brave girl named Sally
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a brave girl named Sally. She liked to play pretend and had a little airplane made from a cardboard box. Sally was so excited to take her pretend plane for a spin! One day, she flew to a nearby station. It was so high up in the sky that Sally was a bit scared. She nervously climbed up the ladder to the very top. From the station, Sally could see for miles! Sally decided to try to soar around the station. She took a deep breath and pushed down on the pedals of her plane. Before she knew it, Sally was soaring high above the station! She circled around the station a few times and felt so brave and strong. Suddenly, she heard someone calling her name. It was her dad!

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a small plastic plant in his room. He loved the plant very much and wanted it to grow big and strong. Every day, he would talk to it and give it water. One day, Tim felt scared because he had a bad dream. He went to his plastic plant and told it about his dream. The plant seemed to listen and it made Tim feel better. As Tim talked to the plant more and more, it started to grow bigger and bigger. Soon, the plastic plant grew so big that it touched the ceiling. Tim was very happy and not scared anymore. passages.text: One day, Anna and Ben went to the zoo with their mom. They saw many animals, like lions, monkeys, and elephants. They liked the elephants the most. They were big and gray, and had long noses and big ears. "Mom, how much do the elephants weigh?" Anna asked. "They weigh a lot, more than a car or a bus," mom said. "Wow, they are very heavy!" Ben said. Then they saw a sign that said "Spirit, the orange elephant". They were curious and followed the sign. They found a small elephant that was orange, not gray. passages.title: Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a loud bird named Lou
passages.text: Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a loud bird named Lou. Lou loved to sing poems all day long. His poems made everyone happy. The town was a very nice place because of Lou's songs. One day, a big storm came to the town. The wind was so strong that it blew Lou far away. The town became very sad without Lou's poems. The people missed Lou and his happy songs. A kind girl named Sue had an idea. She asked everyone in the town to come together and unite. They all held hands and called for Lou. Their voices were so loud that Lou heard them. With the help of their love, Lou found his way back to the town. Everyone was so happy, and Lou sang his poems louder than ever before. The town wa

passages.title: Once upon a time there was a girl who wanted to make something yummy
passages.text: Once upon a time there was a girl who wanted to make something yummy. She had a pear in her hand and decided to prepare it. She started by washing it carefully, then she cut it into small pieces. Finally, she added a bit of sugar on top and looked at the result. It looked delicious! The girl was happy with her work, but she was missing something. She thought for a moment. Suddenly, she remembered somebody who had been very helpful to her before. She asked her helper to join her so that they could enjoy the pear together. The helper was happy to help, of course. The two of them sat down and started eating the tasty pear. They were so happy with the snack they had prepared together.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a small boy who was always playing a game
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a small boy who was always playing a game of hide and seek. One day, he found an old radio. He looked around it and saw that it was very deep. He asked his mom why it was so deep. "It might be hiding something," said Mom with a smile. The boy was excited at the thought of finding something special. He slowly opened the deep radio and found a present! He grabbed the present and hugged it tight. "Thank you for hiding this for me," he said, grinning from ear to ear. His mom smiled and said, "You never know what you'll find if you look deep enough!"

passages.title: Jack was very excited
passages.text: Jack was very excited. He was going to the park with his scooter. As he walked through the park, he whistled a happy tune. Then, he saw a big hill. Despite feeling a little scared, Jack decided he wanted to try and ride down the hill on his scooter. But as he started down, he lost control and crashed into a bush. He was so embarrassed that he felt like he wanted to cry. His sister saw what happened and quickly ran over to him. She said, "It's okay, Jack. Don't be ashamed. Why don't you try again?" Jack shook his head, smiling shyly, and said, "Okay. I'll try again." This time, he was more careful, and he went down the hill easily. He was so proud of himself that he started blowing his whistl

passages.title: One day, a little boy named Tim went for a walk
passages.text: One day, a little boy named Tim went for a walk. Tim was very alert. He saw a zigzag path in the park. He thought it would be fun to walk on it. So, he started to walk on the zigzag path. As he walked, he started to count his steps. "One, two, three," Tim counted. He was having a lot of fun. Suddenly, something unexpected happened. A little bird flew down and landed on the path. The bird started to count too! "Four, five, six," said the bird. Tim was very surprised. He never knew that birds could count. They became friends and counted together. "Seven, eight, nine," they said. And they laughed and played on the zigzag path all day long.

passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a fragile little bird named Billy. Billy loved to rock on the branch of a big tree. Every day, he would rock back and forth, back and forth, singing a happy song. One day, while Billy was rocking, he saw a big cat named Tom. Tom was very hungry and wanted to eat dinner. He looked at Billy and said, "Little bird, you will be my dinner tonight!" Billy was scared but he had an idea. He said to Tom, "If you let me go, I will find you a big, yummy dinner. I promise!" Tom thought for a moment and said, "Okay, but you better be quick!" Billy flew away and found a big, juicy worm. He brought it back to Tom and said, "Here is your dinner, Tom! A big, yummy worm!" passages.title: Ben loved to pack
passages.text: Ben loved to pack. He liked to pack his backpack and pretend he was going on an adventure. He would pack the same things every time: a video, a blanket, and a snack. One day, Ben's mom told him to pack his school bag. He didn't want to, but he did it anyway. He put his favorite video in the bag and said goodbye to his mom. When Ben got to school, he was surprised to find out that today was video day. Everyone was so excited! They all got to watch a video. Ben opened his bag to get his video but it felt hard! He realized he had forgotten to take it out before he left for school. Ben felt silly, but he didn't mind. He just turned to his friend and said, "Let's just watch the same video."

The next day, the small one went to the big one’s house. She wanted to play together. The big one said he was busy but then he had an idea. passages.title: Once upon a time, in a big farm, there was a powerful bull
passages.text: Once upon a time, in a big farm, there was a powerful bull. The bull was very big and strong. One day, the farmer decided to decorate the farm for a big party. passages.title: One day, a big dog and a little cat had a race
passages.text: One day, a big dog and a little cat had a race. The dog was very fast and the cat was patient. They wanted to see who was the fastest. Before the race, the dog said, "I will win!" The cat said, "We will see." They started to race. The dog ran very fast, but the cat took its time. The dog was almost at the end when it saw a big tree. The dog wanted to yell at the cat, so it stopped. It yelled, "You are too slow!" But the cat did not stop running. The cat passed the dog and won the race. The dog was very sad and the cat was very happy.

passages.title: One day, a slow bug named Tim wanted to crawl
passages.text: One day, a slow bug named Tim wanted to crawl. He looked up and saw a ceiling. Tim thought, "I want to crawl on the ceiling!" So, Tim started to crawl up the wall. As Tim crawled, he met a bird named Sue. Sue asked, "Where are you going, Tim?" Tim said, "I want to crawl on the ceiling!" Sue thought for a moment and then said, "I will help you, Tim!" So, Sue picked up Tim and put him on the ceiling. Tim was very happy. But then, something unexpected happened. The ceiling was not strong and it broke! Tim and Sue fell down. They were not hurt, but they learned a lesson. They learned that they should be careful when trying new things.

passages.title: One day, a little girl named Lily wanted to perform a show for her fam
passages.text: One day, a little girl named Lily wanted to perform a show for her family. She put on a pretty dress and a shiny crown on her head. Lily was very excited to make her family smile and clap. Lily's family sat down to watch her show. They were very alert, looking at Lily with big eyes. Lily danced and sang a fun song. Her family smiled and clapped, making Lily very happy. After the show, Lily's mom gave her a big hug and said, "You did a great job, Lily!" Her dad and brother clapped some more. Lily felt proud of her show and loved her shiny crown.

passages.title: Once upon a time, a little boy named Tim wanted to go on a journey
passages.text: Once upon a time, a little boy named Tim wanted to go on a journey. He asked his mom, "Can I go on a journey, please?" His mom said, "No, it is not safe. You are too young." Tim was sad. One day, Tim saw a foolish bird that flew into their house. The bird said, "I can take you on a journey. I will let you ride on my back." Tim was happy and said, "Yes, let's go!" They flew up into the sky. But the foolish bird did not know where to go. Tim and the bird got lost. They were scared. Then, a wise owl saw them and said, "You should not have gone on this journey. Go back home." The owl showed them the way home. Tim learned his lesson and never went on a journey without his mom again.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a reliable friend named Bob. Bob was a talking towel. Tim and Bob did everything together. They played, ate, and even slept side by side. One sunny day, Tim and Bob went to the park. They saw a big tree. Tim said, "Bob, let's spring to the tree and play!" Bob the towel replied, "Yes, let's go!" So, they ran to the tree and played all day long. As the sun set, Tim and Bob were tired. They sat under the tree and talked. Tim said, "Bob, you are my best friend." Bob the towel smiled and said, "You are my best friend too, Tim." And they lived happily ever after.

passages.title: One day, a squirrel went to play in the park
passages.text: One day, a squirrel went to play in the park. The squirrel saw a big tree with pretty flowers that bloom. The squirrel liked the tree and wanted to find yummy nuts. The squirrel looked and looked, but could not find any yummy nuts. Then, the squirrel saw a big, yummy cake on a table. The squirrel thought, "This is not a nut, but it looks yummy!" The squirrel took a big bite of the cake. Just then, the cake started to move! The squirrel was scared. But it was not a cake, it was a big, soft hat! A nice man was wearing the hat. The man laughed and gave the squirrel a yummy nut. The squirrel was happy and went back to the tree with the pretty flowers that bloom.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a big yellow mattress
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a big yellow mattress. It was very soft and comfy. The mattress lived in a store where they sell things for the home. One day, a nice lady came into the store. She saw the yellow mattress and thought it was perfect for her little girl. She decided to buy it and take it home. The little girl loved her new yellow mattress. She slept on it every night and had the best dreams. She was very happy, and the yellow mattress was happy too, because it had found a loving home.

passages.text: Samuel skipped around the playground. He was so happy to play. Suddenly, he noticed a strip of red carpet in the grass. He smiled and ran to it. passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a big field
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a big field. In the field, there was a hidden spot. It was behind a big tree. The tree had many leaves and was very tall. One day, a small cat named Kitty found the hidden spot. Kitty liked it very much. She played there every day. She liked to hide and jump out when her friends came by. One day, Kitty saw a little dog named Spot. Spot was sad. Kitty asked Spot to join her in the hidden spot. They played together and had lots of fun. Spot was happy to have a new friend and a fun place to play. From that day on, Kitty and Spot played in the hidden spot every day. They were very happy together.

passages.title: Once, a little bunny liked to travel
passages.text: Once, a little bunny liked to travel. The bunny had a friend, a small bird. They wanted to find a fair place to play. They went on a trip together. The sun was shining, and they were happy. They saw a big hill. They wanted to go to the top. The bunny hopped and the bird flew. They got to the top of the hill. They saw a beautiful field with flowers. It was a fair place to play. The bunny and the bird played all day. They rolled in the grass and smelled the flowers. They were very happy. When it was time to go home, they said goodbye to the hill. They knew they would come back to play again.

passages.title: One day, a little bird named Timmy was in his nest on a branch
passages.text: One day, a little bird named Timmy was in his nest on a branch. He was very hungry. His mommy bird told him, "Timmy, I will go get some yummy food for us. Stay here and don't leave the nest." Timmy waited and waited. He saw a big red apple on the ground. "Yummy!" he thought. He wanted to eat it. So, he left the nest and flew down to the apple. "I will hurry and eat it before mommy comes back," he said. As Timmy started to eat the apple, a big cat saw him. The cat wanted to catch Timmy. The cat jumped and caught Timmy. Timmy was very scared. He should have listened to his mommy and stayed in the nest. Now, Timmy was in big trouble.

passages.title: One day, a rich man named Bob was walking down the street
passages.text: One day, a rich man named Bob was walking down the street. He saw a little girl named Sue who was sad. Sue lost her toy. Bob wanted to help her find it. Bob said, "Sue, let's look for your toy together." Sue said, "No, I can find it myself." Bob insisted, "I want to help you, please let me." Sue thought about it and said, "Okay, you can help me." They looked and looked for Sue's toy. They went to a big event where people were playing games and eating food. Finally, they found the toy under a table. Sue was very happy and said, "Thank you, Bob, for helping me find my toy!"

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a job. His job was to tear white paper into small pieces. Every day, Tim would sit at his table and tear the white paper. He liked his job. It made him feel big and important. One day, Tim's mom gave him a big, white paper to tear. Tim was so happy! He tore and tore until there were many small pieces on the floor. Tim's mom was proud of him for doing such a good job. They both smiled and laughed as they cleaned up the white paper pieces together.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He wanted to design a kite. He asked his mom, "Can I make a kite?" His mom said, "Yes, you can. But you must be persistent." Tim started to work on his kite. He used paper, sticks, and string. He tried many times, but the kite would not fly. He felt sad, but he did not give up. One day, Tim's kite flew high in the sky. He was so happy. His mom said, "Good job, Tim! You were persistent, and now your kite can fly." Tim played with his kite all day. He was proud of his design.

They both played with the jeep together. "Vroom, vroom!" said Tim. "Let's go on a big adventure!" Sam yawned, "I am sleepy, but let's go!" So, Tim and Sam went on a fun adventure with the jeep. They pretended to drive up hills and through mud. They had a great time. At the end of the day, they were both tired and yawned. They said goodbye, and Tim hugged his jeep, happy to have a compassionate friend like Sam.

passages.title: Bob was taking a walk
passages.text: Bob was taking a walk. He looked all around the neighbourhood. He saw modern cars and buildings. Bob wanted a walk that matched what he saw. Suddenly, Bob saw a brightly coloured toy. He loved it so much and wanted it. He went over to it and saw that it was for sale. He asked the shopkeeper how much it was. The shopkeeper said, "It's very modern and I want you to have it. It's free!" Bob was very happy. He took the toy and went on a long walk with it. It matched the modern life around him. He enjoyed the walk and had fun playing with his new toy. It was the best day ever!
