passages.title: One day, a big, impressive dog named Max went to the park
passages.text: One day, a big, impressive dog named Max went to the park. He saw a small cat named Lily. Lily was sad because she had no food. Max wanted to help Lily. Max said, "I will keep your food safe, Lily. Let's find some for you." They looked for food together. But a mean bird saw them and wanted the food too. The bird tried to take the food away from them. Max and Lily said, "No! This is our food. You cannot have it." The bird was angry, but Max and Lily kept the food safe. They shared the food together and became good friends.

passages.title: Once upon a time, in a big zoo, there was a gorilla
passages.text: Once upon a time, in a big zoo, there was a gorilla. The gorilla was very big and strong. He liked to play with his friends, the monkeys. They would jump and run all day. One day, the gorilla found a small bird that could not fly. The gorilla wanted to help the bird. He was very careful and held the bird in his big hands. The bird was safe and happy with the gorilla. The gorilla and the bird became good friends. They played together every day. The monkeys would watch and clap their hands. The gorilla was happy to have a new friend. And the bird was happy too, because the gorilla held it safe and was always careful.

passages.title: Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a girl named Sue
passages.text: Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a girl named Sue. She had a friend named Tom. They liked to play together. One day, they found a key. It was not an ordinary key. It was shiny and big. Sue said, "Let's find what this key opens!" Tom agreed. They went to the park and saw a big box. They tried to open it with the key, but it was too high. Sue had an idea. "Let's stretch and try to reach it!" she said. They stretched their arms high and opened the box. Inside, they found a bouncy ball. They played with the ball all day, laughing and having fun. They knew they had found something special with the shiny key.

passages.title: Once upon a time, a boy named Tim had a toy pistol
passages.text: Once upon a time, a boy named Tim had a toy pistol. He loved to play with it. One day, he saw a big bug in his room. Tim was scared of the bug. He wanted to make it move away. Tim had an idea. He thought his toy pistol could help him. He was very careful not to get too close to the bug. He pointed the pistol at the bug and made a loud "bang" sound. The bug heard the sound and started to move. It moved away from Tim's room. Tim was so happy that his toy pistol helped him. He played with his pistol all day, feeling brave and safe.

passages.title: Once there was a little dog named Spot
passages.text: Once there was a little dog named Spot. Spot lived in a small house with a big yard. In the yard, there was a long chain. Spot did not like the chain. He would bark and say, "I hate this chain!" One day, the sun was shining bright in the sky. Spot wanted to play outside. He wanted to run and jump and have fun. But the chain was in his way. Spot was very sad. Then, a little girl named Lucy came to visit. She saw Spot and the chain. Lucy knew what to do. She took the chain away and played with Spot all day. Spot was happy and did not hate the chain anymore. They played in the bright sun and had lots of fun.

passages.text: One day, a boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. He wore a thick coat with a zip. Tim saw a big tree and wanted to climb it. His mom said, "Be careful, Tim!" Tim started to climb the tree. He saw a bird and said, "Hi, bird!" The bird said, "Hi, Tim! I admire your coat with the zip." Tim was happy the bird liked his coat. They talked and became friends. Then, something unexpected happened. The bird showed Tim that it could also zip and unzip its feathers! Tim was so surprised. They both laughed and played together in the park.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to pretend to be a wealthy king. He used his toys and other equipment to make his room look like a big castle. One day, Tim found a big box in his room. He thought it would be fun to pretend the box was his treasure chest. He filled the box with all his toys and equipment, so his castle would look more real. But Tim did not know that the big box was not strong. As he played and jumped around, the box started to break. Soon, the box fell apart, and all of Tim's toys and equipment broke too. Tim was very sad because he could not pretend to be a wealthy king anymore.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat ice cream from the big freezer. One day, her mom went out to the store and left Lily at home. Lily thought it was the perfect time to get the ice cream. Lily opened the freezer and saw the ice cream at the back. She tried to get it, but the freezer door closed and Lily felt helpless. She started to panic and cry. Just then, her big brother Tom heard her and came to help. He opened the freezer door and hugged Lily. Tom told Lily that she should always ask for help when she can't do something by herself. Lily learned that it's okay to ask for help and to not panic when she feels helpless.

passages.text: Once there was a girl who was very cold, so her mom gave her a wrap to keep her warm. It was a big wrap and was very dark. The girl put the wrap on and it was soooo warm! She started to feel really cozy and snuggly. Suddenly, she started to feel funny and she sneezed! She jumped up and down and hugged her wrap. The wrap kept her warm and she was happy but still a little bit cold. The wrap was so big that it fit her mom and her too. They twirled around together in the dark and they were so warm and cozy that they couldn't stop laughing. The girl and her mom kept their wrap on, and they never were cold again.

He was a happy boy, and that is all that mattered.

passages.title: One day, a man named Tom was very tired
passages.text: One day, a man named Tom was very tired. He had been working all day in his office. He wanted to go home and rest. But, his boss told him he could not leave yet. Tom was sad and did not know what to do. Tom's friend, Sam, saw that Tom was tired. Sam said, "Why don't you ask your boss again if you can leave?" Tom thought it was a good idea. He went to his boss and said, "Please, can I leave now? I am very tired." His boss looked at Tom and saw how tired he was. He thought for a moment and then said, "Okay, you can leave now. But, you must finish your work tomorrow." Tom was happy and said, "Thank you!" Then, he left the office and went home to rest.

passages.title: Once upon a time, there was a nice, normal dog named Bow
passages.text: Once upon a time, there was a nice, normal dog named Bow. Bow loved to play with his friends in the park. They would run, jump, and chase each other all day long. One day, Bow saw a big, red sign in the park. He did not know what the sign said, but he knew it was something new. Bow called all his friends to look at the sign. They all looked at it and tried to guess what it meant. Bow thought the sign might be asking them to dance. So, Bow and his friends all bowed to the sign, just like they saw people do in their dance. They felt happy and had fun dancing and bowing to the sign. And they played in the park until the sun went down.

His shoes kept coming off when he tried to pedal. Sam said, "I can help you tie your shoes." Sam showed Tom how to tie his shoes. Tom tried and tried, but he could not do it. Then, a big, healthy dog came running over. The dog picked up Tom's shoe in its mouth. The dog was trying to help Tom tie his shoe! Tom laughed and said, "Thank you, dog!" The dog helped Tom tie his shoes. Now, Tom could ride a bike with Sam. They had lots of fun at the park. The big, healthy dog went home with Tom and became his new best friend.

Sue's mom saw her sad face. She had an idea. She found a piece of paper and wrote on it. She made a label that said, "Fix me!" She put the label on the broken block. Sue smiled and said, "Thank you, Mom!" The next day, Sue's dad saw the label on the broken block. He knew how to fix it. He glued the broken block back together. Sue was so happy! She could now create her big tower again with all her blocks. And they all lived happily ever after.
